3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:0158b68a-f3dd.description: What We're Looking For: We’re expanding our Speech Therapy services and need Speech-Language Pathologists (SLPs) to serve as part‑time consultants. Ideal Candidate: - Active SLP license in good standing in Florida - Familiarity with payer credentialing or utilization‑management processes is a plus. - Passion for expanding equitable speech therapy care and experimenting with outcome‑driven models. - Enjoys autonomy and remote, flexible collaboration Compensation Compensation will be $100-150 per hour dependent on experience and geographic location. That’s why we’ve created a platform where SLPs can launch and grow your own practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. For more information, please visit: https://3yhealth.com/specialties/speech-therapy What Makes 3Y Health Different? - $0 upfront to join — No fees, no hidden costs. - Earn up to $320,000/year based on your client caseload and schedule. - Concierge assistance with LLC creation, business banking, and liability insurance. - Total flexibility — You choose your hours, clients, and care model. - World-class support — We take care of operations so you can focus on clinical outcomes. - Custom referral support to help you build your preferred caseload. What We Provide Practice Owners: - All-in-one software suite – Includes Practice Management, Scheduling, EHR, Data Collection, Billing, Onboarding, and mobile apps for you and your clients. - Insurance partnerships – We’re adding new payer partnerships all the time in multiple states - Practice launch support – We’ll help you start your own SLP-focused company if you don’t already have one. - Fast payments – Get paid upfront per session. No more chasing down insurance. - Payroll made easy – We’ll run payroll for you if you’d like.

axlecareers-axle-careers:ashbyhq:772cc71.title: Founders Associate
axlecareers-axle-careers:ashbyhq:772cc71.description: ABOUT US At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here https://www.axle.energy/blog/analysis/power-of-the-home. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a wide-ranging role that’ll require you to move at speed across diverse topics; in return, you’ll gain high levels of ownership and exposure. Example topics include: - entering new markets, from research & analysis to planning & delivery - helping our new and existing clients get the most out of our software - exploring and delivering on opportunities for growth in new verticals and customer segments This is a high-velocity, high-impact role. To succeed, you’ll need to learn quickly, act with purpose, and absorb & process highly technical information. You’ll need to be strong with data, and have a ‘run through walls’ attitude to overcome the inevitable barriers. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity). We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. INTERVIEW PROCESS 1. Initial interview 2. Take-home exercise 3. Final interview (in-person) 4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

jobgether-jobgether:lever:78b885f1-bb63-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Records Manager based in Portugal. This is a flexible, fractional opportunity for an experienced records, compliance, or information governance professional to establish and manage a controlled archive and knowledge-review system. You will play a critical role in determining what information should be preserved, how records are tracked, and what material is ready for entry into a governed knowledge environment. The role combines meticulous records management with responsible use of approved AI tools to accelerate classification and inventory processes. Your judgment will remain central, with every significant AI-assisted decision requiring human verification and careful review. You will work independently, identify risks early, and ensure sensitive information is handled with exceptional discretion. This position is particularly suited to someone who values accuracy, accountability, and strong information governance practices. The engagement is structured as an 8-week pilot with up to 8 hours per week, offering meaningful work without a full-time commitment. Receive, preserve, organize, and track the custody of authorized records and source files throughout the review and archival process. Review incoming information for sensitivity, ownership, completeness, and eligibility for admission into the governed knowledge environment. Use approved AI tools to accelerate information inventory, classification, and review while personally validating all material decisions before they are finalized. Identify and immediately escalate missing, corrupted, incomplete, sensitive, or otherwise high-risk records. Maintain accurate tracking of records, review decisions, outstanding items, and relevant risks. Apply sound professional judgment when determining whether information is suitable for preservation or further review. Provide a concise weekly report covering completed work, remaining backlog, key decisions, and identified risks. Help establish reliable processes and controls for a new or evolving records and knowledge-governance function. Escalate uncertainty or ambiguity rather than making unsupported assumptions, ensuring information is handled consistently and responsibly. Requirements Professional experience in records management, information governance, compliance, audit, legal operations, or a closely related field. Exceptional discretion and demonstrated ability to handle highly confidential or sensitive information responsibly. Strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy, documentation, and records integrity. Comfortable working with AI-assisted tools and capable of identifying errors, limitations, or inappropriate recommendations produced by AI. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document decisions, summarize findings, and communicate risks clearly. Sound judgment and a disciplined approach to escalating uncertainty, inconsistencies, and potential compliance concerns. Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities effectively within a limited-hours engagement. Experience establishing an archive, records-management process, or governance function from the ground up is a plus. Familiarity with legal holds, privacy requirements, cybersecurity practices, or related information governance controls is advantageous. Experience designing human-review controls or quality-assurance processes for AI-assisted workflows is a bonus. A mindset focused on accountability, precision, and preventing unverified information from becoming part of an official knowledge environment. lightfield-lightfield:ashbyhq:f3a6a9c3-1.description: ABOUT LIGHTFIELD Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that assembles itself from your email, calendar, and meetings. It captures every interaction and turns it into organized context: accounts, tasks, follow-ups, and insights, so nothing slips through the cracks. We’re rethinking CRM from first principles. Instead of forcing teams to maintain rigid systems, Lightfield learns from how companies actually work, adapting, automating, and surfacing the insight that drives growth. We’re building the CRM platform we always wished existed: fast, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. The market agrees. Over 5,000 companies have used Lightfield since we launched in November, making us the fastest-adopted product in our category. We are backed by Greylock, Lightspeed, and Coatue, and our founders previously built Tome, a generative AI presentation product used by over 25 million people. Before Lightfield, our team worked on Llama, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Pinterest, Google, and Salesforce. Strategic sells to high growth Series B and C companies ready to make Lightfield their entire GTM system — not a CRM sitting alongside six other tools, but the thing sales, marketing and customer success all run on. That means the sale includes sales methodology, reporting and forecasting, and it means you're replacing systems and process a company has already built around. There aren't many of these deals. Each one runs $80–150K, takes real discovery, and is won across a buying committee rather than with a champion. You'll spend more time on fewer accounts than anyone else, and each one you land changes the company's revenue profile. There's no strategic playbook to inherit. There's a product with real traction, a category argument that hasn't been made yet at this deal size, and a founder who'll be in your deals with you. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own a small book of Series B and C target accounts, self-sourced and worked deliberately - Run deep discovery — how they sell today, what their methodology is, where forecasting breaks, what they've built process around - Multi-thread across sales, marketing and customer success leadership, because the whole GTM is the sale and no one of those three can buy it alone - Design the implementation: what gets migrated, in what order, which team goes live first, what the first 90 days look like - Displace incumbent systems — data, migration and change-management objections alongside product ones - Build the strategic motion itself: target account criteria, the discovery framework, the migration story, the pilot structure - Partner with product on what Series B and C companies need that we don't have yet WHO YOU ARE - 5–10 years selling B2B SaaS, with a documented record closing at $80K+ ACV - You self-source. Tell us what percentage of your closed-won you generated yourself, and how. - Your discovery is the strongest part of your game. At this deal size the win is decided before the demo. - You multi-thread across functions, not just seniority levels. Name the three departments you had to align in your last big deal. - You've scoped an implementation as part of a sale — not handed it to a solutions team after signature. - You've displaced an incumbent system, or replaced a process a company had already committed to. - You've sold at a startup, pre-seed through Series D, and you know what it's like when the answer to "does the product do that" is sometimes not yet. - You sell consultatively. redesignhealth-redesign-health:ashbyhq:1.description: ABOUT THE COMPANY: Redesign Health https://www.redesignhealth.com/ is a global venture and applied technology firm focused on building next-generation healthcare companies. We manage venture capital and venture buyout strategies, each powered by an AI operating system and team of leading technologists, entrepreneurs, and investors. Our venture capital strategy backs exceptional founders at the earliest stage—often before an idea is fully formed—and provides first institutional capital and an unmatched degree of strategic leverage and domain expertise through exit. Our venture buyout strategy partners with proven management teams through control investments and delivers outsized value by rewiring core products and workflows with AI. Since inception in 2018, Redesign and our portfolio companies have touched the lives of more than 15 million patients, raised over $1.5 billion from premier institutional, sovereign, and strategic investors, and built distinctive partnerships with marquee healthcare organizations and senior leaders around the world. Redesign is based in New York and has offices in Bengaluru, Los Angeles, and Riyadh. About the Role: As a New Ventures Principal, you will back exceptional founders at the earliest stage—often before an idea is fully formed—providing first institutional capital and an unmatched degree of strategic leverage and domain expertise through launch and beyond. This role demands generative ideation, exceptional founder judgment, and the ability to sell world-class entrepreneurs on partnering with Redesign Health. You will develop original investment theses in healthcare, identify and attract top 1% founding talent, lead co-ideation and diligence through Investment Committee, and serve as the primary interface between portfolio founders and Redesign’s platform. The core equation: Exceptional Founders × Differentiated Concepts × Redesign’s X-Factors = Power-Law Outcomes. WHAT YOU’LL DO: THESIS & IDEATION: Identify white space in healthcare where AI-native businesses can create outsized outcomes. Develop original, high-conviction investment theses grounded in deep market understanding, clinician pain points, and structural tailwinds. Generate concepts that are bold, differentiated, and commercially viable. Validate theses through primary conversations with clinicians, operators, payers, and potential customers—not just desktop research. Draft compelling collateral that attracts world-class founders to Redesign’s platform. FOUNDER SOURCING, SELLING & CO-IDEATION: Find top 1% founders and convince them that Redesign is their best path to building a generational healthcare company. Build a network that surfaces exceptional talent before anyone else sees them. Demonstrate Redesign’s strategic leverage compellingly enough that founders choose us. Lead a collaborative diligence process (“co-ideation”) to transform thematic areas into venture-scale business concepts. Evaluate concept potential and founder-market fit with the judgment to say no quickly when conviction is lacking—time spent on mediocre opportunities is time away from exceptional ones. DILIGENCE & IC DELIVERY: Stress-test your own theses harder than anyone else will. Identify the 2–3 questions that truly matter for each investment and resolve them through primary conversations and expert input. Shepherd founders and concepts to the Investment Committee with clarity, speed, and honest representation of risks. NETWORK & ECOSYSTEM BUILDING: Develop a robust pipeline of exceptional founders through proactive sourcing across VC networks, healthcare operator communities, and the broader startup ecosystem. Build and maintain deep relationships with tier-one venture capital firms, healthcare incumbents, and strategic investors. Be the person that founders proactively seek out, VCs call for pipeline intelligence, and the industry turns to for a healthcare venture perspective. Your network is a compounding asset—invest in it every week. PORTFOLIO COMP
